in_sanskrit.name: Avhni

in_marathi.name: Avhni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desirable, Wish Fulfilling
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avhni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avhni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'avhan', which means 'desirable'. It is also associated with 'avhana', meaning 'wish-fulfilling'. In Hindu mythology, Avhni is the name of a goddess who is believed to grant the desires of her devotees.
